title: jaxglobal: deterministic global optimization of plain JAX functions
description: jaxglobal is a deterministic global optimizer for continuous and mixed-integer nonlinear problems written as plain JAX functions. It traces the objective and constraints to a jaxpr and re-interprets every primitive as McCormick and alphaBB relaxations, which are jit-compiled and vmapped over boxes in a batched spatial branch-and-bound. It returns a feasible point and a proven lower bound, and reads AMPL .nl models. Documentation: https://kitchingroup.cheme.cmu.edu/jax-go/
